distribution.narrative: Baseline records support Heilongjiang and Jilin; Wang et al. (2021) adds Liaoning and Xinjiang. The synthesis is the union of validated source evidence.

host_note: Baseline Larix hosts are retained; Wang et al. (2021) adds Larix kaempferi, Larix olgensis and Larix sibirica while also confirming L. gmelinii.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Ips subelongatus (Motschulsky, 1860).

taxonomic_history.name: Ips subelongatus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Wang et al. (2021) supports Ips subelongatus as distinct from I. cembrae; stable identity VSN_3434 is retained.
